description: Defines the LogSeverity enum and related functions and operators for logging severity levels in the Abseil library.

classes.name: LogSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of logging severity levels: INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL.

classes.name: LogSeverityAtLeast
classes.description: Enumeration for lower bounds of severity levels used in threshold-based logging.

classes.name: LogSeverityAtMost
classes.description: Enumeration for upper bounds of severity levels used in threshold-based logging.

methods.name: LogSeverities
methods.description: Returns an array of all standard severity levels in order.

methods.name: LogSeverityName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a severity level.

methods.name: NormalizeLogSeverity
methods.description: Normalizes severity values outside the standard range to defined levels.
